limitations: Derived by an REA composed workflow.

Ghidra (ghidra 12.1.4) list_documents, list_procedures, list_segments, list_strings: Cancelling an active Ghidra request terminates its ephemeral database and discards session annotations. The selected target remains open; the next provider query imports the original artifact again.

Ghidra (ghidra 12.1.4) list_documents, list_procedures, list_segments, list_strings: Default-space addresses use lowercase 0x-prefixed hexadecimal; other address spaces use <percent-encoded-space>:0x<hex>.

Ghidra (ghidra 12.1.4) list_documents, list_procedures, list_segments, list_strings: The Windows bridge uses authenticated IPv4 loopback because Node path-based IPC does not expose Java AF_UNIX sockets; the endpoint file contains no bearer token.

Ghidra (ghidra 12.1.4) list_documents, list_procedures, list_segments, list_strings: The imported Program and temporary project are ephemeral and deleted on close. Annotation operations edit session database metadata; original executable bytes are never written.

Ghidra (ghidra 12.1.4) list_documents, list_procedures, list_segments, list_strings: The session serves operations only after Ghidra reports default auto-analysis complete; incomplete analysis does not expose partial results.

Ghidra (ghidra 12.1.4) list_documents, list_procedures, list_segments, list_strings: Windows Ghidra P0 accepts native x86, x86-64, ARMNT (Thumb-2) and ARM64 PE applications and DLLs, and explicitly selected raw 6502 images; managed, hostile, sensitive, and mutable-path targets are unsupported.

Ghidra (ghidra 12.1.4) list_documents, list_procedures, list_segments, list_strings: Windows sessions require the matching packaged Windows x64 native addon, local NTFS targets and runtimes, and Windows 10 or later. Native handles enforce path admission, private DACLs, and Job Object ownership automatically.
Ghidra (ghidra 12.1.4) list_documents: A headless Ghidra session contains exactly one imported Program, unlike Hopper's multi-document GUI session.
Ghidra (ghidra 12.1.4) list_procedures: External functions and local thunks are distinct; procedure metadata identifies both and preserves a thunk target when Ghidra resolves one.
Ghidra (ghidra 12.1.4) list_segments: Memory-block end addresses are exclusive; permissions come from Ghidra MemoryBlock flags rather than inference from section names.
Ghidra (ghidra 12.1.4) list_strings: Charset is reported, while a non-missing terminator cannot distinguish a present terminator from a fixed or Pascal layout.

Ghidra (ghidra 12.1.4) list_strings: Only Ghidra-defined string Data is observed; packed or undefined string bytes may be absent. Completeness applies to that inventory, and an empty search does not establish that text is absent from the artifact. If an address is known, use read_bytes and xrefs to inspect bytes and references.
